openai-api-docs.source: OpenAI API documentation, developers.openai.com/api/docs (platform.openai.com/docs redirects there) — Responses API, models
openai-api-docs.note: Endpoint `https://api.openai.com/v1/responses`, `Authorization: Bearer`; models `gpt-6-astra`, `gpt-5.6-sol` (alias `gpt-5.6`), `gpt-5.6-terra`, `gpt-5.6-luna`, each 1.05M context / 128K output (ADR 0080 §3).

openai-web-search-tool.source: OpenAI API documentation, web search tool guide and models page, developers.openai.com/api/docs
openai-web-search-tool.note: Server-side in the Responses API — `"tools": [{"type": "web_search"}]` — with `url_citation` annotations and a `sources` list; the models page lists Web search in every flagship's tools row (ADR 0080 §3).

routes.note: `max_output_tokens` is optional on this shape and nothing has established a per-turn bound, so the route names none.

openQuestions: The limit reading is not established: no page read states the shape of this endpoint's rate-limit or account-limit response, so a 429 is read as a retryable rate limit (`rate-limit-retryable`, `unverified`) until a page or a named live item says otherwise.

Structured outputs (`text.format` with `json_schema`) and `reasoning.effort` are documented but not implemented by the adapter's Responses assembly, so both stay absent; whether structured outputs are GA is not stated on the pages read.
